default_toggle_keybind: Unbound (0); inherited keyboard and mouse bindings and saved profile settings
description: Barrier blocks use the selected resource-pack glass appearance while enabled. Disabling restores invisible barriers. Collision, hardness, lighting properties and world states are unchanged.

implementation.model: Alias the existing baked glass model in BlockModelShapes for the original barrier block state; rebuild the alias on resource reload.
implementation.layers: Regular uses the existing CUTOUT layer; stained glass uses TRANSLUCENT.
implementation.culling: Skip shared barrier faces and faces against opaque blocks.
implementation.updates: Stop asynchronous chunk compilation before changing shared model state; rebuild chunk renderers only when the effective appearance changes.
implementation.performance: No added per-frame listeners, world scans, render passes or per-block model allocations. Other block model lookups are unchanged. Only barrier render queries read cached appearance state.
implementation.performance_limit: Visible barrier geometry has normal glass mesh, rasterization and translucency costs; changing appearance triggers a one-time chunk rebuild. No in-game FPS benchmark was performed.
